mentions.name: Potniq
mentions.description: This app is a business travel tool that tells users exactly when to leave based on their entire itinerary. It is being extended with an LLM-powered booking email parser that ingests forwarded booking confirmations and automatically adds flights, hotels, and other bookings to the itinerary.
mentions.problem: Frequent event travelers struggle with deciding when to leave on the last day of a conference and end up skipping things like workouts while repeatedly checking the time.
mentions.audience: Business travelers who need to coordinate departures around conference and event schedules.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm a solo dev founder working on Potniq (https://potniq.com) - a business travel tool that tells you exactly when to leave based on your entire itinerary.

mentions.name: Potniq
mentions.description: This web app builds multi-leg travel itineraries (flights, activities, hotels and hotel returns) and suggests departure times for each leg based on predicted traffic patterns, telling users things like "leave your hotel at 7:40am" before an 8:30 meeting — eliminating manual Google Maps checks between itinerary items. It is built as a Remix web app with a NodeJS/Fastify backend, Supabase for storage, and Google Maps for route duration calculations, with native mobile clients planned for the future.
mentions.problem: As a frequent traveler the author built unnecessary time buffers and kept nervously checking a watch or phone to see if planned departure times still held; the tool removes that uncertainty by computing suggested departure times for the whole itinerary.
mentions.audience: Frequent business travelers, though it also works for family leisure trips and daily local itineraries.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://potniq.com

It's a travel tool for business travelers that figures out your suggested departure times for your entire itinerary based on predicted traffic patterns. Think Flighty but for all the non-flight parts of your trip.
